rules.name: Factless bridges contain no monetary columns
rules.details: Factless bridges must never duplicate monetary measures.

rules.details: Award items inherit the governed supplier attribution from their parent award.

rules.name: Contract attribution inherits the governed award supplier
rules.details: Contracts inherit attribution only from a resolved single-supplier award.

rules.name: Contract item attribution inherits its contract supplier
rules.details: Contract items inherit the governed supplier attribution from their parent contract.

rules.name: PEN conversions are reproducible and never invented

rules.name: Every dimension has one unknown member
